header: HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
[Arab Ali Moro v. Province of Sindh and others]
Petitioner : Arab Ali Moro in person.
Respondents by : Mr. Muhammad Sharif Solangi, Assistant A.G
Sindh alongwith Zulifqar Ali Abro Deputy
body: Nisar Ahmed Bhanbhro J:- Through this petition, the petitioner seeks removal of respondents No.3 and 4 from the positions of Zakat Officer, Umerkot and Stenographer, Zakat Office, Mirpurkhas.

2. When confronted as to any illegality in the appointments of respondents No.3 and 4, the petitioner contended that he was victimized at the hands of the respondents; therefore, he has maintained this petition as a revenge. Moreover, he failed to furnish any proof of victimization and the illegal appointments of respondents No.3 and 4.
3. In the circumstances, the petition being devoid of merit, stands dismissed, with no order as to costs.
